products.title: Aurora Smart 58 — RGB App-Controlled LED
products.body_html:
A 24W RGB LED bar for planted freshwater tanks, controlled from your phone. 3150 lumens at CRI 90, across a 58 cm span, with two bracket heights in the box so one light covers tanks from 50 cm to 70 cm tall.

  • Full colour, set from your phone. RGB mixing across the whole spectrum, adjusted in an app rather than by cycling a button on the cord.
  • Colour you can actually judge plants by. CRI 90Ra means greens read as greens. Cheap aquarium LEDs typically sit in the 70s and make a planted tank look flat and grey.
  • 3150 lumens over 58 cm. Enough for medium-light stems and most carpets at this span. The full output figure for every length in the series is in the gallery.
  • Two bracket heights included. Short legs for tanks 50–60 cm tall, tall legs for 60–70 cm. No second purchase, no shimming.
  • Aluminium body, IP44 splash rated. Rated for the splashes and condensation of an open-top tank — not for submersion.

Choosing a length. The series runs 18 cm to 58 cm and 9.1W to 24W. Match the bar to the width of your tank and the bracket to its height — both tables are in the gallery.

faqs.q: What size tank does this suit?
faqs.a: The bar is 58 cm long, so it suits tanks around 58–70 cm wide. Height matters too: the low bracket fits tanks 50–60 cm tall and the high bracket 60–70 cm. Both brackets are included.

faqs.q: Is 3150 lumens enough for carpeting plants?
faqs.a: For most carpets at this span, yes — 3150 lm at CRI 90 over 58 cm is a solid medium light. We do not publish a PAR figure because the manufacturer does not measure one, and we will not estimate it. If you are growing something genuinely demanding, ask us first.
Through a phone app over the light's own wireless link. You set the RGB mix and save it; the fixture keeps that setting.
It is IP44 rated, which covers splashing and the condensation of an open-top tank. It is not submersible and should not be dunked or sprayed directly.

faqs.q: Does it do a sunrise and sunset ramp?
faqs.a: The manufacturer does not document a scheduled ramp for this model, so we do not claim one. What is confirmed is app-based colour and brightness control.
The light bar, both sets of brackets (short and tall), and a 2 m power lead.

products.title: Aurora 48 Planted Tank LED Bar
products.body_html:
A 20W full-spectrum LED bar for planted freshwater tanks between 48 and 58 cm wide (19–23 in). Forty LEDs — thirty daylight white and ten actinic blue — on a retractable bracket, running 90–260V so the same unit works on Australian and US mains.

  • It fits the tank you already own. The bracket slides 10 cm, so one bar covers 48–58 cm of rim. Measure the outside width of the rim, not the water line, and check it against the range before ordering.
  • One unit, either country. 90–260V universal input. No transformer and no voltage-specific variant to get wrong — only the plug head differs.
  • Three modes on an inline switch. All-white for viewing and plant growth, blue-and-white together, or blue alone for a night tank.
  • A timer that repeats. Set the on/off time once and it repeats daily, so light stays consistent while you are away — the main defence against algae from an erratic photoperiod.
  • Slim enough to disappear. A low-profile bar that sits above the rim rather than dominating the tank, in white with translucent blue end caps.

Choosing between lengths. The series runs 18 cm to 58 cm and scales 8W to 24W. Pick by rim width rather than tank volume — a 48 cm bar on a 60 cm tank leaves the ends of the scape visibly dim.

faqs.a: It fits rims from 48 cm to 58 cm (19–23 in). The bar itself is 48 cm and the bracket adds up to 10 cm of travel. Measure the outside width of the rim, not the water line. If your tank is wider than 58 cm, choose the 58 cm model instead.

faqs.q: Will it work on Australian power?
faqs.a: Electrically yes — the driver accepts 90–260 V, so 240 V Australian mains is well within range. Check the plug type on your selected option before ordering; contact us if you need a specific plug and we will confirm what we can supply.

faqs.q: Is it bright enough to grow carpeting plants?
faqs.a: We do not publish a PAR figure for this light because the manufacturer does not provide one, and we will not invent one. What we can state is 20 W across 40 LEDs on a 48 cm bar. If you are growing demanding carpet species, treat this as a low-to-medium light and ask us before ordering.

faqs.q: Does it do a sunrise and sunset fade?
faqs.a: No. It has a repeating on/off timer and three switchable modes, not a gradual ramp. If you specifically want dawn-to-dusk fading, this is not the right fixture.

faqs.q: Can I leave the blue light on overnight?
faqs.a: Yes, the blue-only mode is intended for that. Bear in mind that continuous light of any colour contributes to algae, so most keepers run blue for a few evening hours rather than all night.
The light bar with both brackets fitted, and the inline switch and power lead attached. No timer plug or wall adapter is included.

products.title: Sunrise Timer Controller
products.body_html:
Programmable digital timer with countdown, cycle and daily modes. Pairs with any grow light, CO2 solenoid or air pump.

  • Best for: automating photoperiod on planted tanks and pausing CO2 overnight
  • Modes: daily, weekly, countdown, cycle
  • Rating: 220V, up to 10A
  • Programs: 20 separate on/off events per day

A planted tank runs on rhythm. Lights on for 6-8 hours in the early phase, CO2 solenoid opening one hour before lights and closing one hour before lights out, air pump running overnight. This timer holds all three schedules on one unit, retains programs across power cuts, and displays the current cycle at a glance.
